verdict.rationale: LiveKit's first-party Egress docs state it can record to HLS segments and export live to streaming services such as YouTube Live, Twitch, and Facebook via RTMP. This lets a large audience watch outside the session, and the docs also describe automatic room-start recording. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring an RTMP/HLS live-stream egress (API calls, latency, scaling to large audiences) and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming egress.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session

citations.quote: It supports recording to an MP4 file or HLS segments, as well as exporting to live streaming services like YouTube Live, Twitch, and Facebook via RTMP.
It starts recording automatically when a room is created.
